coarse_request: Please design an integrated order fulfillment and prototype development process that includes the roles of 'customer', 'warehouse employee', 'sales', 'artist', and 'R&D team'. The key activities are 'production', '3D model printing', and 'prototype testing', and there should be decision points regarding 'parts availability', 'sketch satisfaction', 'color availability', and 'prototype refinement'.
fine_grained_text:
Step 1: An order to cash process starts when a customer order is received.
After the order has been processed, it is sent to the warehouse.
The warehouse employees determine the parts required to produce the requested items.
If any parts are not available in the warehouse, these are ordered.
Once all necessary parts are available, production will start.
After production, quality checks will be performed.
If the production process has finished, products will be packaged and labeled, before returning to the warehouse.
Finally, sales will be informed about the completed production and the product can be sold to the customer.
[Transition]: Here is a transition sentence connecting the two processes:

Upon receiving confirmation that the order is complete and ready for sale, the sales department initiates a custom request to print a specific 3D model required for the customer's packaging.
Step 2: Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.
[Transition]: The 3D model printed in Process A serves as the prototype, which triggers the R&D team's testing and refinement cycles in Process B to assess its viability for further development.
Step 3: The process starts with identifying an idea for a new product or improvement to an existing one.
The R&D team conducts initial research and feasibility studies, followed by drafting design concepts.
After selecting a promising design, a prototype is built using available materials and resources.
The prototype undergoes various tests to assess its functionality, safety, and market potential.
Feedback from the testing phase is collected, and the prototype may be refined accordingly.
If a refinement is needed, then the testing phase is reinitiated.
The process ends when the prototype is either approved for further development or discarded.



Please design a prototype development process that only includes the roles of 'R&D team'. The key activities are 'prototype building' and 'prototype testing', and there should be decision points regarding 'prototype refinement' and 'final prototype approval'.
